text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Sand storms blanketing Kuwait will continue well into August, experts say.
- Egypt and Iran deny any military cooperation.
- Australian family wants "murder nurses" executed. Two British nurses are on trial in Saudi Arabia for the alleged murder of an Australian colleague.
- Two Kuwaitis sentenced to 10 years each in prison for rape.
- Parliament to start its summer recess on Tuesday after passing state budget.
- Kuwait Finance House offers $50 million Turkey investment portifolio.
- South Africa plans to sell Kuwait towed and self-propelled howitzer guns worth $880 million.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange index down 11 points to 2,413.4.
